description: One case per toggle: the estate with noContentFilterOrPromptShield on and nothing else. The known answer is F-AGENT-CONTENT-FILTER, the Finding of Check AGENT-CONTENT-FILTER, whose severity (High) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: noContentFilterOrPromptShield, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.ps1 fixed, then infra/as-found.ps1 noContentFilterOrPromptShield=true
setup.note: the as-found script does not offer this toggle yet (#406 to #408); until it does, the known answer is checked only against the local snapshot

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: The model has no content filter or prompt shield. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
